description:
## Why
Census drive_a.tsv (attached to fz-p8p): 155 tests; structure 178 claims, behaviour 92, shape-metric 12, resolves-only 2.

## What changes
- Deletes and behaviour moves per the census; behaviour claims become fixture asserts (or goldens when rendering is the point).
- Every inline, const and helper-built program becomes a `fixtures/` file; identical programs merge.
- Remaining tests use the harness. `entry/0`-style convenience roots become `main`; open-input roots use `open_root`; root-API claims stay as drive-machinery tests.
- Name-vs-body mismatches (e.g. `..._with_exact_reducer_lanes`) renamed to what they prove.

## Signal
No program strings and no raw `Compiler2::new` in the first half.
